estimator.estimator: forward photon density maps with a spectral camera gather

colors.observer: CIE1964 10-degree matching functions from Chroma's bundled table
colors.negative_components: Retain until spectral integration, then gamut clip for display
colors.units: relative radiant packet energy; no per-spectrum or per-frame normalization

fill_light.scope: Low-power ceiling fill evaluated with direct surface visibility; its volume scattering is not included

estimator.normalize_by: all emitted photons N, never detected photon count or histogram maximum
scope: all emitted photons deposit into maps
first diffuse wall reflection; no later diffuse wall interreflection
finite spatial and wavelength bins introduce density-estimation bias
camera visibility and dielectric refraction remain wavelength dependent
RGB display uses a finite spectral approximation and exposure, not absolute photometric calibration
